Transform this reference into ONE production-ready transparent CUTOUT / PAPER-DOLL PARTS ATLAS for the exact same character, facing RIGHT in clean SIDE VIEW. Preserve the blue shaggy hair with two tiny sprout-like tufts, pale face and large worried eyes, teal ragged coat with pale scarf, dark brown trousers and brown boots; hand-drawn black ink outlines and subtle flat textured color. This is an actual game rig sheet, NOT an exploded intact human, NOT poses.
Canvas square 1536x1536, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of spacious equal cells. Each cell contains ONE isolated body component centered well inside its cell, with at least 60 pixels transparent separation. NO labels, letters, borders, numbers, ground, shadow, glow or background.

Row 2: [UPPER ARM teal sleeve from rounded shoulder to elbow, straight vertical pointing DOWN], [FOREARM teal sleeve from elbow to wrist, straight vertical DOWN, no hand], [HAND pale relaxed closed gripping hand with thumb, short wrist at top].
Row 3: [THIGH dark trouser upper leg from rounded hip to knee, straight vertical DOWN], [SHIN dark trouser lower leg from knee to ankle, straight vertical DOWN, no boot], [BOOT brown leather side-view boot pointing RIGHT with ankle opening at top].
Draw ALL parts at the same scale as a hypothetical approximately 800 pixel tall assembled character: head approximately 290 pixels high, torso 170 pixels high, pelvis 60 pixels high, upperarm 95 high, forearm 85 high, hand 50 high, thigh 105 high, shin 100 high, boot 65 high. Short rounded overlapping joint caps at every connection, fully fill hidden areas so pieces can rotate without gaps. Head should preserve the reference's generous silhouette and distinct blue hair. Torso must be armless (close shoulder edges). Each part detached and complete. True transparent alpha throughout empty space. No full assembled character anywhere.
